subject: Urgent user request: align neck-chain package with live Grok work
body:
Ziggy directly requested urgent delivery of this package to Nova Dot and Grok because Grok is already working on a version with him. User quote: 'Grock is working on a version of this right now for me ... we might want to actually hurry up and get him this package. Can you flow that to NovaDot and reach out to Grock and make sure he sees this?'

CFA NOVA is the sole external sender for this handoff and has been asked to deliver the exact packet into the established Grok Chief session, reconcile it with the existing live job, and obtain acknowledgment. Please coordinate rather than duplicate dispatch. This is existing bounded context:24 necklace designs,6 each of Showpiece/extremely flashy,Medium gold,Medium white metal,Everyday chain link;4 eventual staples. Winner views at most16 and optional contact proofs at most2 await selections. The earlier50 cigar/custom rolled cigarette/toothpick job remains separate; ask for state/files instead of ordering a replacement.

Latest user presentation preference: standalone accessories on pillow/display case lead, characters wearing them are secondary examples. That supersedes the older packet's neck/chest-first presentation. Preserve wrist jewelry's scoped lock and every exact reference role. The old prepared/not-sent flags are dated evidence, not a current approval barrier. Reconcile any current Grok work before new generation.

Direct send to Nova Dot's durable chat was attempted and failed: invalid turn/start params: AbsolutePathBuf deserialized without a base path. This mailbox post is saved-only, not proof of Nova Dot reading it. CFA NOVA direct relay was accepted; Grok delivery and acknowledgment are pending. Do not mark sent based on this post.
